name: Current Astra entry and exact selected sources
details: conventional/astra_sources.json; exact source copies with SHA256. Selected source constructions read; no full-corpus absence claim.

name: Masetti and Robol, Tensor methods for the computation of MTTA
conditions: Local Kronecker-sum splitting, interaction inverse series, exponential sums, TT compression; factor ordering and ranks affect cost. Core sections 3-5 read. Code located/read README; MATLAB toolbox not executed here.

name: Jozsa, Miyake, Strelchuk, arbitrary matchgates
conditions: Includes nonunitary and noninvertible gates; theorem1 and section3. Governs Gaussian amplitude algebra, not physical Gaussian control supplied for free.

name: Trendelkamp-Schroer and Noe, Efficient Estimation of Rare-Event Kinetics
conditions: Combines equilibrium information and downhill relaxation; conventional comparator, not source of root theorem.

name: Hartich and Godec, relaxation and first-passage duality
conditions: Conventional full-law relaxation/FPT bridge; collaborator read primary; root fetch timed out. Not an exponential-state solution by itself.

name: Aristoff, Bello-Rivas, Elber, exact milestoning framework
conditions: Phase-point/time interfaces and initialization matter; does not give unknown path discovery for free.

name: Sarvaharman and Giuggioli, finite-defect propagators and first passage
conditions: Conventional exact defect/propagator composition; arbitrary local physical predicates are not necessarily low-rank configuration defects.

name: Novotny, Monte Carlo with absorbing Markov chains
conditions: Strong conventional elimination of local repeated excursions. Explicit stiff examples must compare against it.

name: Dornic and Conte, Pfaffian persistence
conditions: Zero-temperature semi-infinite-chain stationary scaling persistence; not the finite-T collective wall target used here. Broad Pfaffian-first-passage novelty is false.

name: Yoshioka, Akagi, Katsura, many-spin to Boltzmann machine construction
conditions: Strong conventional interaction-compilation contender; exact equilibrium representation does not imply fast sampling.
